imagePath.description: Absolute or project-cwd-relative PNG or JPEG image path.

nitImagePath.description: PNG or JPEG image path for nit notes; falls back to imagePath.

concernImagePath.description: PNG or JPEG image path for concern notes; falls back to imagePath.

blockerImagePath.description: PNG or JPEG image path for blocker notes; falls back to imagePath.

imageMaxWidth.description: Maximum image width in terminal cells.

imageMaxHeight.description: Maximum image height in terminal cells.

bubbleMaxWidth.description: Maximum speech-bubble width in visible columns.

alwaysVisible.description: Keep an idle image and speech bubble visible, and never auto-hide Advisor notes.

displayDurationSeconds.description: Seconds to show each Advisor note; 0 keeps it visible until the next update.
